description:
HushPinterest v0.0.13: 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0, which needs Android 12L or newer. This one adds GmsCore support for phones that use microG-RE instead of Google Play services, so Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default. The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0. Validation: 1069 runtime tests passed. All 241 patch tests passed. All 33 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.41.0. Needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.

### What's new

* **Pinterest:** New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
* **Pinterest:** The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Filter feed
patches.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. A third switch keeps the lens but drops the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. All three start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide survey prompts
patches.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep Home feed
patches.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Long-press download
patches.description: Adds a Download button to the round menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, so you can save a pin without opening it. Slide onto the button and let go. Needs Download pins on too. Three more switches take Pinterest's Save, Send or Search image button out of that menu. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Show posted date
patches.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

release_notes:
HushPinterest 0.0.13 has 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0. It's the first one built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle.

The new patch is GmsCore support, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It sends Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default, so if you don't use microG-RE nothing changes for you.

Patch 14.41.0 with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Pinterest crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- A device lease another session happens to be reading no longer stops a run partway. The check waits a moment and tries again, and a lease that stays locked still stops it.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Pinterest from the release bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator. Then it opens the home feed, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Pinterest crash earns a PASS.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.41.0, version code `14418010`. APKMirror has it as an arm64-v8a bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer. Pick that file in Manager and it merges the parts before patching.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.41.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Reported issues

- #15: GmsCore support is new in this release, for signing in with Google on a phone that has microG-RE instead of Play services.

## Validation

All 241 patch tests and 1069 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.41.0 bundle from APKMirror with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 33 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.13.json` records that result, the bundle's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched a Pinterest that went on an Android emulator for a walk through the whole app: the home feed, a pin, notifications, searches for pins, boards and people, and all ten HushPinterest settings pages. Pinterest didn't crash once.

GmsCore support was tried on an emulator with microG-RE installed. Pinterest opened microG-RE's Google sign-in at launch, and Continue with Google went on to microG-RE's account screen. That emulator had no Google account added, so a full sign-in wasn't done there.
repoDescription: HushPinterest Morphe patches for Pinterest. Hides promoted pins, AI-labeled pins, and much more.
